description:
[Admin] Read the company's portal configuration as editable documents: `branding` (portal name, style, colours, logos, e-mail sender name), `interview-portal` (languages, home texts), `coaching-portal` (vertical, feature toggles, labels, languages, home blocks) and one `jobmojito.portal-site` document per portal (every page's draft content and the theme CSS). Narrow with `sections` (branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal, interview-pages, coaching-pages): the page documents are the large ones. This is the read step of every portal change: read the section(s) involved, change only what the user asked for, and send those documents back with update_portal_configuration. Field reference: https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/branding, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/interview-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/coaching-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/portal-pages.

Reads the company's portal configuration as import documents: branding, the interview portal, the coaching portal, and the pages + theme CSS of each portal. Every returned document can be edited and sent back to portal-configuration-update unchanged in shape (preview with `dry_run: true` first). Document formats: https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/branding, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/interview-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/coaching-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/portal-pages.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections to return (default: all): branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal, interview-pages, coaching-pages. A portal the company does not use is left out of the default; name its sections to read them anyway.

name: get_portal_configuration

documents.description: One document per section, each a valid input for portal-configuration-update: `kind: "branding"`, `kind: "interview-portal"`, `kind: "coaching-portal"`, and one `format: "jobmojito.portal-site"` per portal (`portal: "interview"` for interview-pages, `"consumer"` for coaching-pages) with every page's DRAFT content and the theme CSS draft. Pages also carry `published_at` (read-only, ignored on import; null = never published). The support / application-tracking / interview-completed / signed-in home texts are built-in pages ("_support", "_tracking", "_completion", "_signed_in_home") and appear only in the portal-site documents.

items.description: One configuration document: declares either `kind` (branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal) or `format` (jobmojito.portal-site, jobmojito.portal-page), plus that type's fields. Field reference: branding https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/branding, interview portal https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/interview-portal, coaching portal https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/coaching-portal, portal pages https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/portal-pages. Unknown fields are ignored with a warning; wrong types and enum values are errors.

format.description: Portal site document type. `jobmojito.portal-site`: `{ portal, theme: { css }, pages: [Page] }`, a whole site (pages in every language, the menu, the footer and the theme CSS). `jobmojito.portal-page`: `{ page: Page }`, one page. Page = `{ slug, show_in_menu, sort_order, languages: [{ mojito_language_code, title, description, blocks }] }`; slug "" is the home page, "_footer", "_support", "_jobs" etc. are the built-in pages.

kind.description: Portal configuration document type. `branding`: portal name, style, colours, logos, e-mail sender name, speech term boosting. `interview-portal`: interview portal languages and the per-language home texts. `coaching-portal`: coaching portal vertical (`use_case`), feature toggles, label overrides, coaching plan, catalogue start directory, languages and per-language home blocks. A portal site document declares `format` instead.

title: Get portal configuration
